agents.name: Gambit
agents.description: Deploys a drone swarm that boosts allies' shields and repair rate and grants immunity to status effects.
agents.story: Born to rebuild the terms of a fight, Gambit turns his allies' hulls, tracks, and shields into problems the enemy solves twice, and every hit that lands on him becomes a signal he traces straight back to its source. Where other Agents defend a position, Gambit defends the whole team, and makes attacking him a mistake in itself.
